title: Japan 30-Year JGB auction (issue 92 first reopening expected) — the control leg of the bucket-taper difference-in-differences, eight days before its 20-year pair
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18 initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 10, 2026 | 30-year'. No size is asserted: no November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-11-03. The 30-year has been offered at ¥600bn since 2026-04-07 per MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (parsed 2026-09-09 — ¥800bn through 2025-06-05, ¥700bn 2025-07-03 to 2026-03-05, ¥600bn from 2026-04-07), so ¥600bn is the base case, not a claim. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) on MOF's own November calendar. It earns a slot on one term: it is the CONTROL LEG of the difference-in-differences that three ledgers in this family now turn on. jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 predicted that the BoJ's taper of the 'more than 10 and up to 25 years' purchase bucket would damage 20-year auction demand first; jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 tested it month-matched against the 30-year and found a null with the sign reversed (tail gap +0.453bp -> +0.041bp, DiD -0.412bp, t = -0.77). That test is month-matched, so every 20-year observation needs its 30-year partner in the same calendar month, and this is November's. It is also what keeps the pair position-matched: MOF has run the two tenors' issue cycles in exact lockstep since 2013-06-18 (158 consecutive month-matched pairs, 100% position-matched, measured 2026-09-09 from the Auction Results workbook), and on that rhythm 2026-11-10 is issue 92's FIRST REOPENING against issue 198's first reopening on 2026-11-18 — a 159th matched pair. The most recent 30-year prints are primary-sourced from MOF result pages the workbook does not yet carry: 2026-08-06 (issue 91, tail 1.5bp, cover 3.86) and 2026-09-03 (issue 91, tail 2.1bp, cover 3.79, average yield 4.079% against 3.937% a month earlier). NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and the JGB-auction-to-US-long-end association does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
